card.name: Last digit inside split-up dose numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit (0, 5, 8) that finishes a number split into pieces, such as the 0 in 240 or 720 or the 5 in 112.5 or 1,125. It appears mostly in dose amounts before mg.

modes.label: Final 0 in round doses
modes.description: The digit 0 ends a number like 240 or 720 right before mg.
modes.example: recommended dosage is one 480 mg tablet once daily or two 24<<0>> mg tablets once daily

modes.label: Final 5 after a decimal or comma
modes.description: The digit 5 ends numbers such as 112.5 or 1,125 in dose lists.

card.plain: It fires on the last digit of a dose number that is written in pieces, such as 240 mg or 112.5 mg.
